Name: DIY Pets CP
Author: puutaeto
Description:
Inspired by (and being a longtime user of) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9156323]LavenderLight[/url]'s DIY CP packs, this Content Patcher pack allows you to drop in whatever dog or cat replacements you like! If you edit the included animal cursors files, it will also change your pet in the menu display! Now also allows you to change your horse!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/N2fpf2Z/diypetcp.gif[/img]

[b]This pack is for the Stardew Valley 1.6+ update[/b], which changes where the animal's faces are, so if you try to use it for older versions, it will patch the wrong place and look weird! If you look in the old versions, there are versions compatible going back as far as SDV 1.4!

How To Use:
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]In this mod's folder, open the assets folder. Edit or replace the pngs with ones of your choice.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]That's it!
[/list]
